component.name: Proton Pass
component.summary: Open-source and end-to-end encrypted password manager

description.p: Proton Pass is an end-to-end encrypted password manager with support for logins, passkeys, credit cards, notes, aliases and two-factor codes.
This is an unofficial AppImage, repackaged unmodified from Proton's official Debian package. It is not affiliated with Proton AG.
